source.title: Crop Advisory Knowledge Base
source.citation: Crop Advisory Knowledge Base v1.1 (Minna edition), prepared 15 October 2026.

crops.name: Yam
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Dec-May (mounds); harvest Sep-Dec
crops.notes: Planted on mounds in the dry season to early rains, grows through the rains, harvested at the end. Needs staking and well-drained mounds. Avoid the poorly drained plinthic soils common around Minna.

crops.name: Maize
crops.plantingWindow: Plant May-Jul (rainy); dry-season only with irrigation
crops.notes: Heavy nitrogen feeder.

crops.name: Beans
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Jun-Aug (rainy); dry-season fadama possible
crops.notes: 'Beans' read as cowpea, the common Nigerian bean. Common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) is more heat and salt sensitive.

crops.name: Guinea Corn
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Jun-Jul; harvest Oct-Dec
crops.notes: Drought tolerant; host of Striga.

crops.name: Rice
crops.plantingWindow: Rainfed lowland: plant Jun-Jul. Dry-season fadama/irrigated: Dec-Jan
crops.notes: Main crop on Minna's poorly drained fadama and lowland soils. Flooded paddy assumed. Upland rice behaves like a dryland cereal (see rules).

crops.name: Groundnut
crops.plantingWindow: Plant May-Jul
crops.notes: Pods form underground; needs loose soil and calcium.

crops.name: Soya Beans
crops.plantingWindow: Plant late Jun-Jul (daylength sensitive; choose variety)
crops.notes: Needs correct rhizobia; photoperiod sensitive, so variety matters.

crops.name: Tomatoes
crops.plantingWindow: Best as dry-season fadama crop (transplant Nov-Dec); rainy-season crop has heavy wilt and blight
crops.notes: Fruit set fails in heat (above about 32 C day / 25 C night). In Minna, best as dry-season fadama crop (Nov-Feb); rainy-season crop suffers wilt and blight.

crops.name: Pepper
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Apr-Jul, or dry-season with irrigation
crops.notes: Shares bacterial wilt and nematodes with tomato.

crops.name: Millet
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Jun-Jul
crops.notes: Most drought tolerant cereal on the list; host of Striga.

crops.name: Okro
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Apr-Jul, or dry-season with irrigation
crops.notes: Highly susceptible to root-knot nematodes.

crops.name: Bambara Nut
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Jun-Jul
crops.notes: Pods underground like groundnut; hardy on poor soil.

crops.name: Cassava
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Apr-Jul at start of rains (also Aug-Sep); harvest 9-18 months
crops.notes: Long cycle; heavy potassium remover.

crops.name: Spinach
crops.plantingWindow: Rainy season and year-round with irrigation; first cut 4-6 weeks
crops.notes: In Minna 'spinach' means green amaranth, a heat-tolerant leafy vegetable grown in the rains and with irrigation. True spinach (Spinacia oleracea) bolts in Minna heat and is not covered.

crops.name: Hibiscus
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Jun-Jul (short-day crop); harvest Oct-Dec
crops.notes: Roselle ('zobo'). Not the same as okra (formerly Hibiscus esculentus).

crops.name: Sweet Potato
crops.plantingWindow: Plant vines Jun-Sep on ridges, or fadama in the dry season; harvest 3-5 months later
crops.notes: Planted from vine cuttings on ridges or mounds, late rains and fadama. Not a Solanaceae, so it can follow tomato or pepper. Sweet potato weevil (Cylas) damage worsens in cracked dry soil.

crops.name: Sheanut
crops.plantingWindow: Permanent tree; do not clear
crops.notes: Protected economic parkland tree; Niger State is part of the shea belt. Treated as a permanent component, not a rotation crop.

crops.name: Sesame
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Jul-Aug (late rains)
crops.notes: Poor weed competitor; sensitive to waterlogging.

crops.name: Sugarcane
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Oct-Mar with irrigation or at start of rains; 12-18 months
crops.notes: Needs lots of water (irrigated or fadama in Minna dry season); occupies the plot for years.

crops.name: Garden Egg
crops.plantingWindow: Plant Apr-Jul, or dry-season with irrigation
crops.notes: Shares bacterial wilt and nematodes with tomato.

crops.name: Onions
crops.plantingWindow: Dry-season fadama only: transplant Nov-Dec, harvest Feb-Mar
crops.notes: Dry-season fadama/irrigated crop only in Minna (transplant Nov-Dec, harvest Feb-Mar). Rainy-season onion fails from purple blotch and basal rot. Shallow rooted; needs frequent light irrigation and full sun.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Beans, Guinea Corn, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Millet, Bambara Nut
rotations.fairAfter: Rice, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sesame, Sugarcane, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.reason: Yam nematodes (Scutellonema bradys), anthracnose and tuber rots carry over; plot also loses K.

rotations.goodAfter: Yam, Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Bambara Nut, Cassava, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Rice
rotations.reason: Stem borers, Striga and Fusarium build up under repeated cereal; a legume year restores N.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Rice, Millet, Cassava, Spinach, Sugarcane, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Garden Egg
rotations.poorAfter: Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut, Sesame
rotations.reason: Macrophomina, root-knot nematodes, Maruca pod borer and bean fly carry over in legume residue.

rotations.goodAfter: Yam, Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Bambara Nut, Cassava, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Rice
rotations.reason: Striga hermonthica seed bank, head smut and shoot fly build up under continuous sorghum.

rotations.goodAfter: Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Tomatoes, Pepper, Bambara Nut, Garden Egg
rotations.fairAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Millet, Okro, Cassava, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Onions
rotations.reason: Flooded paddy tolerates repeat cropping, but yield declines from weeds, blast and nutrient imbalance; break with a legume or fallow every 2-3 crops.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Rice, Millet, Cassava, Spinach, Sugarcane, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Garden Egg
rotations.poorAfter: Beans, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut, Sesame
rotations.reason: Sclerotium rolfsii, leaf spots, rosette and aflatoxin risk persist in soil and residue.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Rice, Millet, Cassava, Spinach, Sugarcane, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Garden Egg
rotations.reason: Frogeye leaf spot, rust inoculum and nematodes carry over; rhizobia are not the problem.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Rice, Millet
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut, Cassava, Spinach, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Sugarcane, Onions
rotations.reason: Ralstonia bacterial wilt, Fusarium, root-knot nematodes and blight persist 2+ years. Applies to the whole Solanaceae family.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Rice, Millet
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut, Cassava, Spinach, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Sugarcane, Onions
rotations.reason: Bacterial wilt, Phytophthora blight and nematodes persist. Applies to the whole Solanaceae family.

rotations.goodAfter: Yam, Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Bambara Nut, Cassava, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Rice
rotations.reason: Downy mildew, smut and Striga build up under repeated millet.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Millet, Spinach, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Beans, Rice, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut, Cassava, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Sugarcane
rotations.reason: Root-knot nematodes, Fusarium wilt and yellow vein mosaic reservoir. Applies to the Malvaceae family (okro and hibiscus).

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Rice, Millet, Cassava, Spinach, Sugarcane, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Garden Egg
rotations.reason: Cercospora leaf spot, Fusarium and nematodes carry over.

rotations.goodAfter: Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut
rotations.fairAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Rice, Tomatoes, Pepper, Millet, Okro, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sesame, Sugarcane, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.reason: Soil K depletion, root rots and cassava mealybug/whitefly build-up; break with legume or cereal.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Beans, Guinea Corn, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Millet, Bambara Nut
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Rice, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Cassava, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Sugarcane, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.reason: Leaf blight (Choanephora), damping-off and root-knot nematodes build up; amaranth also self-seeds and becomes a weed.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Millet, Spinach, Onions
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Beans, Rice, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut, Cassava, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Sugarcane
rotations.reason: Root-knot nematodes and stem rot. Applies to the Malvaceae family (okro and hibiscus).

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Beans, Guinea Corn, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Millet, Bambara Nut
rotations.fairAfter: Rice, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sesame, Sugarcane, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.reason: Sweet potato weevil (Cylas), root-knot nematodes, Fusarium wilt and the virus complex build up; always plant clean vine cuttings.

rotations.goodAfter: Not rotated: annuals are interplanted outside the canopy edge
rotations.fairAfter: n/a
rotations.reason: Permanent tree crop. No rotation; the plot is locked while trees stand. Annuals are interplanted, not rotated.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Millet
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Rice, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Cassava, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Sugarcane, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.poorAfter: Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut
rotations.reason: Macrophomina charcoal rot, Fusarium wilt and phyllody inoculum persist; sesame is also a poor competitor on weedy fields.

rotations.goodAfter: Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Tomatoes, Pepper, Okro, Cassava, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Garden Egg, Onions
rotations.reason: After 2-4 ratoons yield and soil structure decline; plough out and use a legume break before replanting.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Guinea Corn, Rice, Millet
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Beans, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Bambara Nut, Cassava, Spinach, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Sugarcane, Onions
rotations.reason: Bacterial wilt, nematodes and shoot/fruit borer carry over. Applies to the whole Solanaceae family.

rotations.goodAfter: Maize, Beans, Guinea Corn, Groundnut, Soya Beans, Tomatoes, Pepper, Millet, Bambara Nut, Garden Egg
rotations.fairAfter: Yam, Rice, Okro, Cassava, Spinach, Hibiscus, Sweet Potato, Sesame, Sugarcane
rotations.reason: White rot, basal rot, purple blotch and nematodes persist in soil and cull piles.
